title: Erosion and transport process sheet
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y7 lesson 16 (Erosion and transport process sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 16: How rivers shape the land: erosion, transport, deposition. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

parts.text: Scrape against the bed and banks

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Load scrapes the bed and banks (1), wearing them away like sandpaper (1)

keywords.def: the force of water breaking rock
rocks carried by the river scraping the bed and banks
rocks knocking together and wearing down

questions.a: Rocks in the river knock into each other (1), so they become smaller and rounder (1)

questions.q: When does a river deposit its load?
questions.a: When it loses energy, for example when it slows down

questions.q: Core: Make a process diagram showing four erosion and four transport processes with labelled sketches.
Extend: Home mini-experiment (written guide): shake sugar cubes in a jar for 2 minutes and describe the result. Which process does it model?
questions.a: Corners rounded and crumbs form: attrition

questions.q: Stretch: Why does more erosion happen in a flood?
questions.a: More water and speed means more energy and load for abrasion and hydraulic action

questions.q: Rocks bouncing along the bed is:
questions.a: B) Saltation. Saltation is a bouncing movement of pebbles and sand.

questions.q: Big question: how can water cut through solid rock?
questions.a: Hydraulic action, abrasion by its load and solution wear rock away over a very long time
